detail.longDescription: The next round of the "Feminist Linux Meetup" in Vienna for FLINTA* people is on Wednesday, the 2nd of December. The topic is "Intro to Cascading Style Sheets". This time we'll look into Cascading Style Sheets (CSS), which are used to style HTML pages, not only to make it visually appealing, but also to keep it accessible. In this workshop our speakers will give a short intro into CSS. We will touch on basic concepts like Selectors, Inheritance and Specificity but also layout concepts like Flexbox and Grid. We will learn how to select and style HTML elements and troubleshoot broken styles, and yes, we will center that <div>. There will be a short presentation followed by a workshop part with challenges and games that are suitable for beginners as well as advanced CSS users. After the workshop you will be able to solve the most common CSS problems, know how to approach more complex tasks. Additionally, we will have a few of the wonderful Wizard Zines by Julia Evans lying around on how CSS works. If you want to actively participate in the workshop, all you need is a computer/notebook with a browser like Firefox, Chromium, Safari, etc. More details here: https:// feminist-linux.diebin.at/2026/ 11/22/0x20-intro-to-cascading-style-sheets-on-december-2nd/ Find the Wizard Zines here: https:// wizardzines.com/ Wednesday, 2nd of December 2026, from 17:30, Vordere Zollamtsstraße 7, 1030 Vienna, University of Applied Arts, room Flux1 on the 3rd floor: https://www. openstreetmap.org/way/176477793 # vienna # wien # css # webdev # flinta
